sources.title: Toolfarm reseller listing of Cinema 4D subscription pricing

keyLimits.en: Includes Redshift GPU rendering and 5 Team Render nodes at no extra cost; annual billing saves roughly 30%+ vs monthly.

plans.name: Maxon One (bundle: Cinema 4D, Redshift, Red Giant, ZBrush, Forger, Universe)

keyLimits.en: Bundle price varies by source (some show ~$99.91-105.41/month billed annually with promotions); official rate not independently re-confirmed beyond the buy page tabs in this session.

cautions.en: The official maxon.net/en/buy page splits pricing across Individuals/Teams/Educational/Mobile/Reseller tabs and did not render specific numeric rates during automated fetch; figures above are corroborated by a reseller (Toolfarm) and should be re-verified against the live tabs.

capabilities.en: Full 3D content creation suite for motion graphics, modeling, animation and rendering, considered a reference tool in motion design.
Includes Redshift GPU renderer and Team Render distributed rendering nodes bundled with every subscription.

limitations.en: No free tier; requires an ongoing paid subscription (monthly or annual) to use.
Full feature set (SSO, dedicated license dashboard, premium support) is reserved for the Teams pricing tier, not the individual plan.

reason.en: Free, open-source general-purpose 3D suite covering modeling, animation and rendering.
Autodesk's industry-standard 3D animation and VFX software, direct competitor in professional studios.
Autodesk's 3D modeling and rendering tool, commonly compared for motion graphics and viz work.

missingAlternatives.name: Houdini
missingAlternatives.reason: Major procedural 3D/VFX competitor frequently compared to Cinema 4D, appears only as an alternativeCandidate, not in currentAlternatives.

unknowns: Exact current Maxon One bundle price not independently confirmed; the official buy page's specific dollar figures did not render in this session's automated fetch.
Trial period length (if any) not confirmed on the official site.
